messages:
Samir Patel (Sales): Passing Veridian / VertaLabs to CS. Closed 6-seat Dedicated + Private deployment. They require SSO (Okta), SCIM, on-prem connector PoC, and higher SLA. Procurement is slow; legal asked for SOC2 evidence. Renewal ~10 months out — moderate risk.
Lina Gomez (CS): Got it. Onboarding snapshot: infra request submitted; provisioning window tentatively 2026-03-29. API credentials staged. Need customer to confirm Okta metadata and primary infra contact.
Samir Patel (Sales): Customer prefers enablement Tues 2026-04-06 afternoon PT. They used ~20% trial credits and want cost predictability before ramp.
Rachel Ortiz (Acct Exec): Also asked about burst capacity during training windows. We promised to send burst pool pricing options and impact on SLA.
Onboarding Bot: Ticket ONB-483 created: private-deploy provisioning. Status: env bootstrap started.
Igor Petrov (Support): SSO notes: Okta SAML + SCIM. We will need their metadata.xml and SCIM attribute mapping. Engineering will need a small task to add a metadata endpoint if customer's provisioning tool requires it.
Emily Chen (Solutions): I can run a 45min infra session covering batching, KV cache sizing, quantization tradeoffs. Need their concurrency and sequence-length targets beforehand.
Lina Gomez (CS): Action list (owners/due dates): 1) Samir 1 send Okta metadata + primary contact (due 2026-03-25). 2) Igor 1 open ENG ticket for metadata endpoint + attach ONB-483 (due 2026-04-02). 3) Emily 1 prepare enablement deck + runbook (due 2026-04-03). 4) Rachel 1 draft burst pricing & SLA note (due 2026-03-28). 5) Lina 1 schedule enablement 2026-04-06 14:00 PT and send calendar invites (due 2026-03-26).
Samir Patel (Sales): Sharing contact: michael.huang@vertalabs.com will send Okta metadata today.
Igor Petrov (Support): I'll create ENG-715 (SSO connector) and link to ONB-483. If they require on-prem installer, we'll produce a network/firewall checklist.
Emily Chen (Solutions): For the session, please ask Veridian for a perf target matrix: tokens/sec per user, p95 latency target, nightly batch sizes. That lets me recommend quantization and batching profiles and a cost estimate.
Lina Gomez (CS): Risk flags: add tags on account: "SOC2-pending", "private-deploy", "renewal-10mo". If SOC2 not confirmed by 2026-04-10 escalate to legal (marcus.legal@redwood.ai).
Rachel Ortiz (Acct Exec): I'll include a short note in the burst pricing draft on how burst affects latency SLOs and cost per token.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: enablement session created for 2026-04-06 14:00 PT. Calendar invites pending.
Samir Patel (Sales): FYI procurement also asked about data residency guarantees. I'll confirm by EOD.
Igor Petrov (Support): Noted. Posting ENG-715 link once created and will attach any sample nginx reverse-proxy config for on-prem PoC.
Emily Chen (Solutions): I'll include a 100k tokens/day cost/run example in the deck and a checklist for sequence lengths and cache sizes.
Lina Gomez (CS): Follow-up: check-in on 2026-03-26 to confirm tasks started. Short-term owners: Samir / Igor / Emily / Rachel. I'll upload this thread to the account playbook and add the readiness checklist. :thumbsup:
